```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

orig_render_figure_template <- render_figure_template
render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()
  options$placement <- "!htbp"
  if (is.null(options$max_height) || identical(options$max_height, "none")) {
    options$max_height <- "0.42\\textheight"
  }
  return(orig_render_figure_template(arg0_file_path, options))
}
```

```{r load-json, include=FALSE}
fmt_num <- function(x) {
  if (is.null(x) || is.na(x)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(x)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000000.0, format = "f", digits = 2L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000.0, format = "f", digits = 1L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord <- function(lat, lon) {
  ns <- ifelse(lat >= 0, "N", "S")
  ew <- ifelse(lon >= 0, "E", "W")
  paste0(
    format(round(abs(lat), 2), nsmall = 2, decimal.mark = ","), "°", ns, " ",
    format(round(abs(lon), 2), nsmall = 2, decimal.mark = ","), "°", ew
  )
}

fmt_year <- function(y) {
  yi <- as.integer(y)
  if (yi < 0) {
    paste0(abs(yi), "BC")
  } else {
    paste0(yi, "AD")
  }
}

wrap_long_tokens <- function(txt) {
  txt <- as.character(txt)
  if (length(txt) == 0 || is.na(txt) || !nzchar(txt)) return("-")
  if (!knitr::is_latex_output()) return(txt)
  tokens <- strsplit(txt, " ", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  out <- vapply(tokens, function(w) {
    if (nchar(w) <= 10) return(w)
    chars <- strsplit(w, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
    res <- character(0)
    for (i in seq_along(chars)) {
      res <- c(res, chars[i])
      if (i %% 6 == 0 && i < length(chars) - 2 && chars[i] != "-" && chars[i + 1] != "-") {
        res <- c(res, "\\-")
      }
    }
    paste(res, collapse = "")
  }, character(1))
  paste(out, collapse = " ")
}

build_subregion_df <- function(subreg_code) {
  keys <- names(gaz_data)[!is.na(subreg_map[names(gaz_data)]) & subreg_map[names(gaz_data)] == subreg_code]
  rows <- lapply(keys, function(k) {
    s <- gaz_data[[k]]
    p_list <- s$population
    yrs <- as.integer(names(p_list))
    vals <- as.integer(unlist(p_list))
    ord <- order(yrs)
    yrs <- yrs[ord]
    vals <- vals[ord]

    start_yr <- yrs[1]
    end_yr <- yrs[length(yrs)]
    span_str <- ifelse(start_yr == end_yr, fmt_year(start_yr), paste0(fmt_year(start_yr), " - ", fmt_year(end_yr)))

    pre1600_idx <- which(yrs < 1600)
    if (length(pre1600_idx) > 0) {
      max_i <- pre1600_idx[which.max(vals[pre1600_idx])]
      pre1600_str <- paste0(fmt_num(vals[max_i]), " (", fmt_year(yrs[max_i]), ")")
    } else {
      pre1600_str <- "-"
    }

    get_bench <- function(target_yr, tol = 25) {
      exact_i <- which(yrs == target_yr)
      if (length(exact_i) > 0) return(fmt_num(vals[exact_i[1]]))
      near_i <- which(abs(yrs - target_yr) <= tol)
      if (length(near_i) > 0) {
        best_i <- near_i[which.min(abs(yrs[near_i] - target_yr))]
        return(fmt_num(vals[best_i]))
      }
      return("-")
    }

    alt_vec <- unlist(s$other_names)
    alt_str <- if (length(alt_vec) > 0) paste(alt_vec[1:min(2, length(alt_vec))], collapse = "; ") else "-"

    data.frame(
      Settlement = wrap_long_tokens(s$name),
      `Native / Alternate Names` = wrap_long_tokens(alt_str),
      Coords = fmt_coord(s$coords[[1]], s$coords[[2]]),
      `Active Span` = span_str,
      `Pre-1600 Peak` = pre1600_str,
      `1700` = get_bench(1700, 45),
      `1800` = get_bench(1800, 35),
      `1850` = get_bench(1850, 25),
      `1897` = get_bench(1897, 5),
      `1900` = get_bench(1900, 2),
      check.names = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  })
  do.call(rbind, rows)
}
```

# Abstract

Across the 10,11M km² of Eastern and Pacific Siberia, early settlement clustered at productive salmon, seal and river-crossing sites such as Pleistocene Ushki I-V in Kamchatka (45 residents in 10000BC) [@Goebel2003], High Arctic Zhokhov (38 residents in 6000BC) [@SikoraPitulko2019], Early Neolithic Kitoi camps at Shamanka II and Lokomotiv on Lake Baikal [@Weber2016a] and the large Neolithic pit-house village on Suchu Island in the Lower Amur (185 residents in 3000BC) [@Filatova2018]. During the Bronze Age, Early Iron Age and Middle Ages, permanent winter villages and walled towns (*gorodishcha*) emerged across the southern steppe and monsoon valleys: Karasuk Torgazhak (150 residents in 1000BC) [@Legrand2006], Xiongnu Ivolga Fortress in Transbaikalia (2,8k residents in 100BC) [@Vasyutin2022], the Uyghur fortresses of Por-Bajin and Shagonar in Tuva (800AD) [@Tulush2016], the Bohai port of Kraskinskoye (2,2k in 800AD) [@Gelman2018] and the Jurchen Jin and Eastern Xia mountain cities of Krasnoyarovskoye (15k in 1220AD) and Shayginskoye (3,8k) in Primorye [@Artemyeva2013; @Artemyeva2025], alongside Bering Strait whaling villages at Ekven and Uelen (250-300 residents) [@Dneprovskiy2017] and Sakha *alaas* settlements at Sayylyk and Ayyy-Taybyt [@Kiryanov2019]. From the 17th century, Russian river forts (*ostrogi*) founded at Yeniseysk (1619), Krasnoyarsk (1628), Yakutsk (1632), Irkutsk (1661), Nerchinsk (1658) and Petropavlovsk (1740), followed after 1858 by the Far Eastern ports and railway cities, grew into an urban network led in 1897-1900AD by Irkutsk (51,5k in 1897), Blagoveshchensk (32,8k), Vladivostok (28,9k), Krasnoyarsk (26,7k), Khabarovsk (15k), Chita (11,5k) and Yeniseysk (11,5k) [@Kabuzan1985; @Troinitskiy1905; @Patkanov1912].

# Methodology

This gazetteer presents the coordinates, native and historical names, dates of occupation and population estimates for 231 settlements across Eastern and Pacific Siberia from 10000BC to 1900AD (Figure \ref{fig:hero}; Tables \ref{tab:ii1} to \ref{tab:iv3}). Occupation spans correspond to the earliest and latest benchmark dates recorded for each settlement.

Prehistoric camp and pit-house village figures are derived from excavated house counts, floor areas and cemetery sizes [@Chernykh2022; @Weber2016a; @Kuzmin2006; @AlekseyevDyakonov2009; @Fitzhugh2016; @Dneprovskiy2017]. Estimates for Iron Age and medieval fortified settlements (*gorodishcha*) in Transbaikalia, Tuva, Khakassia, the Amur Basin and Primorye are drawn from walled areas and excavated house-pit totals [@Vasyutin2022; @Tulush2011; @Tulush2016; @Artemyeva2013; @Artemyeva2025; @Gelman2018; @Ivliev2021]. Early Russian forts (*ostrogi*), 18th-century mining and border towns and 19th-century towns are compiled from *yasak* and garrison rolls [@Dolgikh1960; @Chertykov2009; @Ushnitskiy2017a; @Turaev2013], poll-tax revision lists and urban histories [@Kabuzan1985; @Mansheev2010; @Kurchatova2015; @Kyshpanakov2022a; @Kolomiets2022; @Rygalova2024] and the First All-Russian Census of 1897 [@Troinitskiy1905; @Patkanov1912].
